title: Mastering Model Evaluation: K-Fold Cross-Validation Techniques Explained

cues.en: Instructor: All right, welcome back.
cues.zh: 好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today, we're talking about K-Fold Cross-Validation, a very important tool in your toolkit for assessing how well your model is working with the data that you have.
cues.zh: 今天談 k 折交叉驗證，它是工具箱裡非常重要的工具，用來評估模型對現有資料的表現。

cues.en: Okay, so here is what we normally do.
cues.zh: 通常我們會這樣做。

cues.en: We have a dataset and we usually split it into a training set and a test set.
cues.zh: 有一份資料集，通常切分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And from here, we're going to talk about k-fold cross-validation.
cues.zh: 從這個基礎開始，討論 k 折交叉驗證。

cues.en: But first, I wanted to make a quick note that
cues.zh: 不過先簡單補充，

cues.en: there are two schools of thought, well, basically, one school of thought is that when you're doing k-fold cross-validation, you don't need the test set.
cues.zh: 有兩種看法，第一種認為做 k 折交叉驗證時，不需要測試集。

cues.en: It is enough to do k-fold cross-validation.
cues.zh: 只做 k 折交叉驗證就足夠。

cues.en: In the second school of thought, you still do the test set and you do k-fold cross-validation on the training set and then you still use the test set later on.
cues.zh: 第二種則仍保留測試集，在訓練集上做 k 折交叉驗證，之後再使用測試集。

cues.en: So those are two different approaches.
cues.zh: 這是兩種不同做法。

cues.en: We are going to talk more about that at the end of this tutorial.
cues.zh: 這堂課最後會進一步討論。

cues.en: Throughout this tutorial, we're going to use the second school of thought because it's more general and then we'll be able to like simplify it
cues.zh: 教學過程先採用第二種，因為比較一般化，之後再簡化，

cues.en: to make it appropriate for the first school of thought at the end of this tutorial when we discuss it.
cues.zh: 在最後討論時，調整成第一種看法的做法。

cues.en: So for now, let's stick to breaking the dataset into a training set and a test set.
cues.zh: 所以現在先將資料集切成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: Now, once you've broken it down, what you do next for k-fold cross-validation, so normally what you would do is you would just train your model here and then test your model here, right?
cues.zh: 切分之後，k 折交叉驗證要做什麼？通常會在這裡訓練模型，再在這裡測試，對吧？

cues.en: And from that you would get like a result.
cues.zh: 由此得到一個結果。

cues.en: Yes, the model hasn't seen this data, so you'd be able to tell how well it performs on this test set.
cues.zh: 模型沒看過這些資料，所以可以知道它在這個測試集的表現。

cues.en: But what if you just get lucky on this test set?
cues.zh: 但如果只是剛好在這個測試集運氣好呢？

cues.en: What if it just so happens that it show, it does well on test set but then on future data, it's not gonna do well at all?
cues.zh: 如果碰巧測試集表現好，但未來資料完全不行呢？

cues.en: So that's what k-fold cross-validation is for.
cues.zh: k 折交叉驗證就是為了解決這種情況。

cues.en: It's here to combat that scenario where you just got lucky on the test set to ensure with more certainty that your model is doing well.
cues.zh: 它能降低只是碰巧在測試集表現好的疑慮，更有把握模型確實表現良好。

cues.en: So what we're going to do is we're gonna take the training set, we're gonna split it into 10 folds.
cues.zh: 做法是取出訓練集，切成 10 折。

cues.en: It's actually k-folds, but for our tutorial, for simplicity's sake, we're just gonna assume K equals to 10.
cues.zh: 其實是 k 折，但為了教學簡單，假設 K = 10。

cues.en: So we're splitting into 10 folds.
cues.zh: 所以切成 10 折。

cues.en: A fold is just a fancy word for saying, we're gonna split into 10 parts.
cues.zh: 「折」只是比較正式的說法，就是分成 10 份。

cues.en: Each part is about, they all about the same in size and they don't overlap.
cues.zh: 每份大小大致相同，而且彼此不重疊。

cues.en: Then what we're going to do is we're going to train the data on nine of these folds and keep one fold as an unseen fold for validation.
cues.zh: 接著用其中 9 折訓練模型，留 1 折當成未見過的驗證資料。

cues.en: So that's gonna be our training data and that's gonna be our validation data.
cues.zh: 這部分是訓練資料，這部分是驗證資料。

cues.en: Think of it as a basically, training data, testing data, but we're gonna use validation so we don't confuse with this testing data.
cues.zh: 可以想成訓練與測試資料，但這裡叫驗證，避免與原先的測試集混淆。

cues.en: So we're gonna train it on this, this data of these nine fold, and then validate or find our metrics and calculate whatever we need to calculate of how well our model is performing on this validation set,
cues.zh: 用這 9 折資料訓練，再對驗證集評估、計算所需指標，了解模型表現，

cues.en: validation fold because it has not seen it before.
cues.zh: 也就是驗證折，因為模型先前沒看過它。

cues.en: Great, then we're gonna do that again, but now we're going to shift the validation fold.
cues.zh: 很好，接著再做一次，但這次移動驗證折。

cues.en: The validation fold becomes this fold.
cues.zh: 驗證折換成這一折。

cues.en: So now we're going to train the data on this data set, right, on these ninefold.
cues.zh: 現在用這份資料集，也就是這 9 折，訓練模型。

cues.en: And as you can see, it's slightly, so the training data has slightly changed and the fold is completely new or the validation fold is completely new.
cues.zh: 可以看到訓練資料稍有改變，驗證折則完全換了一份。

cues.en: And again, it's not gonna be seen during this training.
cues.zh: 同樣，這一折在這次訓練中不會被看見。

cues.en: So we're gonna get a new model as a result of this training, a new trained model, and we're gonna validate on this fold.
cues.zh: 訓練後得到新的已訓練模型，再在這一折驗證。

cues.en: And note every time we do this for every fold or every like combination of folds.
cues.zh: 注意，每次對每一折，或者每種折的組合做這件事時，

cues.en: So here and here, we have to use the same hyperparameters.
cues.zh: 這裡和這裡都必須使用相同超參數。

cues.en: Very important, so we've decided on our hyperparameters and now we're just training the model again and again on slightly different training data
cues.zh: 這非常重要。已經決定超參數，只是用稍微不同的訓練資料，一次又一次訓練模型，

cues.en: and validating it on the validating fold, which is changing, which is shifting as you can see.
cues.zh: 再在不斷更換、移動的驗證折評估。

cues.en: So here's our six training.
cues.zh: 這是第六次訓練。

cues.en: So we train it on all of this data and then validate it on this fold, which is not seen during training.
cues.zh: 用這些資料全部訓練，再用訓練時沒看過的這一折驗證。

cues.en: So we keep doing that and we keep shifting.
cues.zh: 持續這樣做，持續移動。

cues.en: So if we have 10 folds, we're gonna have to do train more 10 train, train 10 models, and each time we're gonna use the same hyperparameter.
cues.zh: 如果有 10 折，就要訓練 10 個模型，每次使用相同超參數。

cues.en: So the model hyperparameter, the model and the hyperparameters are the same during training, of course, it will result and it'll be a different, slightly different result.
cues.zh: 模型類型與超參數相同，但每次訓練當然會產生稍微不同的結果。

cues.en: And then we'll validate it on the validation fold.
cues.zh: 再用驗證折評估。

cues.en: And as a result, we will have 10 sets of metrics.
cues.zh: 最後得到 10 組指標。

cues.en: Remember, if we just did the training set and the test set, just the normal two, then we would have one set of metrics that we could've gotten lucky.
cues.zh: 記得，如果只做一般訓練集／測試集切分，就只有一組指標，可能只是運氣好。

cues.en: Whereas here, we're going to have 10 sets of metrics.
cues.zh: 這裡則有 10 組。

cues.en: It's much less likely that we got lucky 10 times, right?
cues.zh: 連續 10 次都只是運氣好的可能性小得多，對吧？

cues.en: So it's much more reliable now that we're going to have 10 sets of metrics and we can look at them in aggregate and that's exactly what we're going to do.
cues.zh: 因此更可靠，可以整體檢視這 10 組指標，這正是接下來要做的。

cues.en: So let's make some space and here we're going to assess these metrics and look at them in aggregate.
cues.zh: 騰點空間，這裡評估指標，整體檢視。

cues.en: And if these metrics look good in aggregate, then the modeling approach is valid.
cues.zh: 如果整體指標良好，表示這種建模方式可行。

cues.en: So the model you've selected and the hyperparameters you selected are good for this data.
cues.zh: 所選模型與超參數適合這些資料。

cues.en: And then what we're going to do is we're going to train the model.
cues.zh: 接著再訓練模型。

cues.en: Again, go and train the model one more time, one last time.
cues.zh: 再訓練一次，也是最後一次。

cues.en: This time we're gonna train on all of the training data and then we're going to test it on the test set as usual.
cues.zh: 這次使用全部訓練資料，再像平常一樣用測試集測試。

cues.en: That's our final step.
cues.zh: 這是最後一步。

cues.en: On the other hand, if the aggregate metrics don't look good, then something's wrong, then otherwise, we need to, if so, basically, they don't look,
cues.zh: 反之，如果整體指標不好，代表有問題，需要……也就是，

cues.en: if they don't look good, we need to adjust hyperparameters of the model or we have to change the model entirely and repeat this whole process of k-fold cross-validation.
cues.zh: 需要調整模型超參數，或完全更換模型，再重做整個 k 折交叉驗證流程。

cues.en: So that's what k-fold cross-validation is and that's how it works.
cues.zh: 這就是 k 折交叉驗證，以及運作方式。

cues.en: As we discussed at the beginning, there's a few schools of thought, this was the second school or they don't really have numbers.
cues.zh: 開頭說過，有不同看法，這是第二種，或者其實沒有固定編號。

cues.en: This was one of the schools of thoughts that says we should have the training set, apply k-fold cross-validation to the training set, assess the metrics, then retrain the model on the training set once we are happy
cues.zh: 其中一種看法是保留訓練集，在訓練集做 k 折交叉驗證、評估指標，滿意後再用完整訓練集訓練模型，

cues.en: and then still test on test set.
cues.zh: 最後仍用測試集測試。

cues.en: The other school of thought says, let's get rid of this testing step, right?
cues.zh: 另一種看法是，省略測試這一步。

cues.en: So we've already run the model here many times and we've tested it on these validation metrics.
cues.zh: 因為模型已在這裡執行多次，也用這些驗證指標測過。

cues.en: So we're just going to train the model on the training set and we will, no need to test it anymore.
cues.zh: 所以最後只在訓練集上訓練，不再另外測試。

cues.en: We've tested it, we know it works.
cues.zh: 已經測過，知道可以運作。

cues.en: Then there's a modification of that school of thought as well where you don't even train it on this training set anymore.
cues.zh: 這種看法還有變形，甚至不再用完整訓練集訓練。

cues.en: So you just say, okay, well, we've trained the model 10 times here, we've got 10 different models as a result, we've tested all of them.
cues.zh: 認為這裡已訓練 10 次，得到 10 個不同模型，而且全都驗證過。

cues.en: So we don't need to do the test and we're not gonna do the training, we're just gonna pick one of these models.
cues.zh: 所以不做測試，也不再訓練，直接挑一個模型。

cues.en: That is kind of like a little bit challenging in my view.
cues.zh: 我認為這有點棘手。

cues.en: Like how do you pick which one to go with?
cues.zh: 要怎麼選呢？

cues.en: You're going to just take the one of the best metrics or the closest metrics to the average.
cues.zh: 選指標最好，還是最接近平均的模型？

cues.en: So it creates a little bit of extra work to pick the model out of these.
cues.zh: 從這些模型中挑選，反而多了一點工作。

cues.en: 'cause they're all gonna be slightly different models because the underlying training data was slightly different.
cues.zh: 因為底層訓練資料稍有不同，所以它們都是稍微不同的模型。

cues.en: So that's also an option.
cues.zh: 這也是一個選項。

cues.en: And then there's yet another modification of how to think about k-fold cross-validation.
cues.zh: 還有另一種理解 k 折交叉驗證的變形。

cues.en: What you could do is you could take this part and do it first, you know, do the classic part first, split your data into a training set and a test set,
cues.zh: 可以先做這一段，也就是先做傳統流程，分成訓練集與測試集，

cues.en: train your model on the training set, test it on the test set, and then if you're happy with the results of this classic approach, you could go an extra step and apply k-fold cross-validation.
cues.zh: 在訓練集訓練、測試集測試；對傳統方法結果滿意後，再多做一步 k 折交叉驗證。

cues.en: So do all of this, but after you've done the training and testing, and so then, once you've done all of this, if your aggregate metrics still look good, then you can confirm
cues.zh: 也就是訓練與測試之後，再做這些。如果整體指標仍然很好，就能確認，

cues.en: and say, well, I'm happy that even like, like I didn't get lucky on the test set.
cues.zh: 並說：很好，測試集表現不是純粹運氣好。

cues.en: Basically, it was indeed, the fact that it works on the test set is, is not just a chance, in reality, I tested it later,
cues.zh: 基本上，模型在測試集有效不是偶然，因為後續又測過，

cues.en: I tested it with k-fold cross-validation, still works.
cues.zh: 用 k 折交叉驗證測試，仍然有效。

cues.en: So I'm just gonna keep my original model that I trained in this first approach.
cues.zh: 因此保留一開始訓練的原始模型。

cues.en: So in this case, k-fold cross-validation is acting as like an add-on to your classic method.
cues.zh: 這種情況下，k 折交叉驗證就像傳統方法的附加步驟。

cues.en: So it's kind of the same thing as we discussed as the, what's it called, (chuckles) the general, the most general k-fold cross-validation when you do all this first and then you train,
cues.zh: 和剛才所謂最一般化的交叉驗證大致相同，原本是先做這些，再訓練，

cues.en: and then you test, it's kind of the same thing, but it's just doing it backwards.
cues.zh: 再測試，這裡只是順序反過來。

cues.en: So you can do that too.
cues.zh: 所以也可以這樣做。

cues.en: Whatever you're happy with, whatever works for you, as long as you know why you're doing it and you know like what results you're aiming for
cues.zh: 採用自己合適、能運作的方式，只要知道為什麼做、希望得到什麼結果，

cues.en: and you know how to assess the indications that k-fold cross-validation is giving to you.
cues.zh: 並知道如何評估 k 折交叉驗證提供的訊息。

cues.en: The rest of the details, there's no like one hard and fast way that you have to do it as long as you get the out or get the benefits of k-fold cross-validation that you're aiming to get.
cues.zh: 其餘細節沒有唯一絕對固定的做法，只要能得到希望從交叉驗證取得的效益。

cues.en: And of course, you don't let the validation data leak into the training data.
cues.zh: 當然，不能讓驗證資料洩漏進訓練資料。

cues.en: So you don't let the model see the validation data during training or the test set during training set if you're doing those.
cues.zh: 也就是訓練時不能讓模型看到驗證資料，如果另外保留測試集，訓練時也不能看到它。

cues.en: Okay, so that's k-fold cross-validation.
cues.zh: 好，這就是 k 折交叉驗證。

cues.en: Congratulations on adding a new powerful tool for model assessment to your toolkit and I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 恭喜工具箱又多了強大的模型評估工具，期待下次見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
